docs.title: OpenBuilder-dev
docs.text:
OpenBuilder is a graphical and command-line tool for building Martini coarse-grained membrane and membrane–protein systems.

It supports:

  • Membrane-only systems
  • Membrane systems with coarse-grained proteins
  • Martini v3 force fields
  • Reproducible JSON-based builds
  • GUI and CLI workflows
  • Automatic zipped output folders

docs.title: 🚀 Main Workflow
docs.text: GUI input → Config object → System build → config.json → ZIP archive

docs.title: 📁 Output Structure
docs.text:
Each build creates a self-contained project folder:

outputs/OpenBuilder-YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM-SS/
├── config.json
├── user_inputs/
├── simulations/
├── toppar/
└── mdp/

docs.title: 📦 Zipped Output
docs.text:
A compressed archive is also created automatically:

downloads/OpenBuilder-YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM-SS.zip

This archive contains everything needed to reproduce the system, including:

  • Input files (user_inputs/)
  • Configuration (config.json)
  • Simulation setup files

docs.title: CLI Usage
docs.text:
OpenBuilder can run without the GUI using a saved JSON configuration.

python app.py --no-gui config.json

docs.title: 🎯 Why use the CLI
docs.text:
The CLI mode is useful for:

  • Repeating a previous build
  • Quickly swapping proteins
  • Automating workflows
  • Running batch simulations

docs.title: 1. Create a configuration via GUI
docs.text:
streamlit run app.py

Build your system once. This generates a project folder with a config.json.

docs.title: 2. Re-run using CLI
docs.text: python app.py --no-gui outputs/OpenBuilder-xxxx/config.json

docs.title: ✏️ Editing configurations
docs.text:
You can modify config.json to:

  • Change protein files
  • Adjust membrane composition
  • Modify box size or number of systems

This enables fast iteration without reopening the GUI.

docs.title: 📦 Output
docs.text:
The CLI produces the same outputs as the GUI:

  • Project folder in outputs/
  • ZIP archive in downloads/
  • Full reproducibility via config.json

docs.title: GUI Usage
docs.text:
OpenBuilder can be launched using Streamlit:

streamlit run app.py

docs.title: 🧭 What you can configure
docs.text:
The GUI allows you to configure:

  • System type (membrane or membrane + protein)
  • Box size
  • Martini force field
  • Membrane composition
  • Solvation and salt molarity
  • Number of replicas (systems)
  • Protein input files
  • Protein placement and rotation

docs.title: 🚀 Build Process
docs.text:
Press the BUILD button to generate your systems.

This will create a project folder:

outputs/<project_name>/

and automatically generate a downloadable ZIP archive.

docs.title: 🧬 Protein Input Files
docs.text:
For protein-containing systems, upload:

  • A coarse-grained .pdb file
  • The corresponding .itp topology file

These files are copied into:

user_inputs/

inside the output project folder, ensuring the build is fully reproducible.

docs.title: 📦 Output Summary
docs.text:
After building, you will have:

  • A complete project folder inside outputs/
  • A ZIP archive in downloads/
  • All inputs and configuration stored for reuse

docs.title: Stable version
docs.text:
git clone https://github.com/lolicato/OpenBuilder.git
cd OpenBuilder

docs.title: Development version (specific branch)
docs.text:
git clone -b development https://github.com/lolicato/OpenBuilder.git
cd OpenBuilder

docs.title: 🐍 Conda Environment
docs.text:
We recommend installing OpenBuilder using a Conda environment:

conda env create -f environment.yml
conda activate OpenBuilder # activate OpenBuilder-dev for development version

docs.title: GUI mode
docs.text: streamlit run app.py

docs.title: CLI mode
docs.text: python app.py --no-gui outputs/OpenBuilder-xxxx/config.json

docs.title: 📦 Notes
docs.text:
• coby is used for system generation
  • MDAnalysis handles structure manipulation
  • streamlit provides the GUI
  • streamlit-molstar enables 3D visualization

docs.title: 🔧 Optional (Documentation)
docs.text:
If you want to build the documentation locally:

pip install mkdocs mkdocs-material "mkdocstrings[python]"
mkdocs serve

docs.title: JSON Configuration
docs.text:
Each build writes a config.json file inside the output folder.

This file stores the full build configuration and allows full reproducibility of the system.

docs.title: 📄 Example Configuration
docs.text:
{
    "output_name": "outputs/OpenBuilder-2026-05-03_20-00-20",
    "selected_ff": "martini_v3",
    "base_folder": "",
    "selected_module": "membrane_with_cg_protein",
    "box_x": 10.0,
    "box_y": 10.0,
    "box_z": 20.0,
    "box_type": "rectangular",
    "solvation": "solv:W pos:NA neg:CL salt_molarity:0.12",
    "salt_molarity": 0.12,
    "n_systems": 3,
    "pdb_path": "outputs/OpenBuilder-2026-05-03_20-00-20/simulations/R0003/protein.pdb",
    "itp_path": "outputs/OpenBuilder-2026-05-03_20-00-20/toppar/protein.itp",
    "randomize_pos": true,
    "randomize_pos_every": true,
    "randomize_rot": true,
    "randomize_rot_every": true,
    "cx": 0.0,
    "cy": 0.0,
    "cz": 0.0,
    "z_method": "Height above Membrane",
    "distance_to_mem": 3.0,
    "rx": 0.0,
    "ry": 0.0,
    "rz": 0.0,
    "lipid_mode": "",
    "membrane_string": "grid_maker_grouping_algorithm:no_groups leaflet:upper lipid:POPC:0.5:charge:top:params:TOP:apl:0.6 lipid:BSM:0.5:charge:top:params:TOP:apl:0.6 leaflet:lower lipid:POPC:1.0:charge:top:params:TOP:apl:0.6",
    "abs_lip_vals": false,
    "lipid_entries_relative": [
        [
            "POPC",
            0.5,
            1.0,
            0.6,
            0.6
        ],
        [
            "BSM",
            0.5,
            0.0,
            0.6,
            0.6
        ]
    ],
    "lipid_entries_absolute": [],
    "entries": [
        [
            "POPC",
            0.5,
            1.0,
            0.6,
            0.6
        ],
        [
            "BSM",
            0.5,
            0.0,
            0.6,
            0.6
        ]
    ],
    "imported_lipids": []
}

docs.title: 🧱 System
docs.text:
• selected_module
  • "membrane"

  • "membrane_with_cg_protein"

  • selected_ff

  • Force field (currently martini_v3)

docs.title: 📦 Box
docs.text:
• box_x, box_y, box_z → size in nm
  • box_type → currently "rectangular"

docs.title: 🧂 Solvation
docs.text:
• solvation → string passed to COBY
  • salt_molarity → numeric version (used internally)

docs.title: 🔁 Replicas
docs.text: • n_systems → number of independent systems generated

docs.title: 🧬 Protein
docs.text:
• pdb_path → protein structure
  • itp_path → topology

These are automatically copied into:

user_inputs/

docs.title: 📍 Placement
docs.text:
• z_method
  • "Absolute z position"

  • "Height above Membrane"

  • distance_to_mem

  • Used only for height-based placement

docs.title: 🎲 Randomization
docs.text:
• randomize_pos
  • randomize_pos_every
  • randomize_rot
  • randomize_rot_every

Controls variability across replicas.

docs.title: 🧬 Membrane Composition
docs.text:
Each lipid entry follows:

[lipid_name, upper, lower, apl_upper, apl_lower]

Example:

["POPC", 0.5, 1.0, 0.6, 0.6]

docs.title: Relative mode (abs_lip_vals = false)
docs.text: • Values must sum to 1.0 per leaflet

docs.title: Absolute mode (abs_lip_vals = true)
docs.text: • Values are lipid counts (integers)

docs.title: ⚠️ Notes
docs.text:
• membrane_string is generated automatically → do not edit
  • entries is an internal field
  • output_name is set automatically

docs.title: 🚀 Reuse
docs.text: python app.py --no-gui outputs/OpenBuilder-xxxx/config.json

docs.title: Output Structure
docs.text: OpenBuilder writes all builds into the outputs/ directory.

docs.title: 📁 Project Folder
docs.text:
Each build creates a self-contained project:

outputs/OpenBuilder-YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM-SS/
├── config.json
├── user_inputs/
├── simulations/
├── toppar/
└── mdp/

docs.title: 📄 config.json
docs.text:
Stores the full configuration used for the build.

  • Enables full reproducibility
  • Can be reused with CLI mode

docs.title: 🧬 user_inputs/
docs.text:
Contains all uploaded input files:

user_inputs/
├── protein.pdb
└── protein.itp

These files are copied automatically and included in the final ZIP.

docs.title: 🔁 simulations/
docs.text:
Contains one folder per replica:

simulations/
├── R0001/
├── R0002/
└── R0003/

Each folder includes:

  • generated system files
  • topology (topol.top)
  • simulation outputs (.gro, etc.)

docs.title: ⚛️ toppar/
docs.text:
Contains force field and topology files:

  • Martini force field files
  • protein topology (protein.itp)

docs.title: 🧪 mdp/
docs.text:
Contains simulation parameter files:

  • energy minimization (em.mdp)
  • equilibration (eq*.mdp)
  • production (md.mdp)

docs.title: 📦 ZIP Archive
docs.text:
A compressed copy of the entire project is automatically created:

downloads/OpenBuilder-YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM-SS.zip

This archive includes everything needed to reproduce the system.

docs.title: ✅ Summary
docs.text:
Each build is:

  • Fully self-contained
  • Reproducible via config.json
  • Ready for simulation workflows
